blocks.text: We are going to have a great time ahead. You cannot count what he has done here (Capstone Cathedral). The Lord is way ahead of time. He is going to bless. There is no greater wisdom than the way the Lord does things to fool the devil. He will put it right in front of them and make them think it is the devil, that is, those who don’t believe in Him. How many of you can say, Praise the Lord? He is good at that. We know it is supernatural, don’t we? It’s the power of God. The true Pentecostals know His word. They know that signs and wonders follow the word of the Lord. They know His presence and they know that the work is of the Lord. I am saying this because of what Jesus Himself had to go through. Many of you have been anointed by God. You have the word of God. Don’t ever go by what people tell you. Only rely on the word of God. Be confident in yourself and the Lord, and you will be blessed. So, great times are coming. I really believe that. I want you to get a hold of the Lord in a special way. Don’t be negative. Always in your heart; think about what he is going to do, think about the fact that you are getting closer to the translation. Remember that your time is getting shorter on the earth. You have only a second to work. Time is like a vapor; keep that in your heart. We have to be careful at the end of the age because everything that comes will not be from the Lord. They may come in His name, but it will be a trick. We won’t be deceived because we know the word of the Lord.

“The word of God shall come alive in their hearts and I shall put a flame in their hearts and tongues. I shall guide them with spiritual eyes. They shall surely hear spiritual things tonight. For I have hidden some of this and will reveal it now (Brother Frisby’s word of prophecy).

Now, the Most Precious Anointing: The Most Precious Anointing costs something and it can cost you your life. Isaiah 61: 1 – 3 and Luke 4: 17 -20 are the same kind of scriptures and they match each other. There are some marvelous insights in these two scriptures. I felt led of the Lord to bring this revelation out. Today, the Lord moved on me, I saw this revelation and he brought it to me. Turn with me to Luke 4: 17 – 20. Then, we will go to Isaiah and see how the two scriptures match. There is much more to these scriptures than most realize. He had not even started His ministry and they wanted to kill Him right there because of the anointing. a. “And there was delivered to him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book… (Luke 4: 17). He called for that book or the word “delivered” would not have been there. He chose the book of Isaiah to inaugurate the power on Him. He could have chosen the book of Daniel, who He loved very much, or any of the other prophets or the psalms. But at this point in the gospel of Luke, he chose the book of Isaiah. Isaiah is a book within a book in the bible b. “The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath chosen me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised” (v. 18). “To preach the acceptable year of the Lord” (v. 19). “And he closed the book…. And the eyes of all of them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him” (v. 20). He began to talk to them. Right away, tension was in the air. Bitterness and hatred began to come upon them as He read the scripture because of the anointing on Him. They wondered at His words. They said marvelous things had come out of the mouth of Joseph’s son. They had yet to know Him. Jesus came to the Jews, the lost sheep of Israel. By this, He was letting them know that the people He was sent to were predestined; it was providential the very ones he would speak to. He spent two days with the Samaritans, but he was sent to the Jews (John 4: 40). Later, His disciples went to the Gentiles. He was telling them that God had sent Him to those who had been appointed by faith; the rest, He came to them as a witness. But the people did not believe Him because they did not understand the scriptures. c. “But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias…. But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow” (vs. 25 & 26). That was Elijah the prophet. He mentioned Elijah for a purpose. One time Obadiah said to Elijah, “I am afraid you will disappear” (1 Kings 17: 12). God used Elijah in a special way. Sometimes, he disappeared and was transported. Eventually, he disappeared altogether. Jesus mentioned that because he was about to do something. Then, He mentioned Elisha cleansing Naaman, the leper, because those two (the widow and Naaman) were appointed to come to the ministries of these two prophets. Others were left with nothing. Elijah was only appointed to go to that widow. d. He continued to talk to them and a powerful anointing began to go into motion. The power of that light that was on Him was incredible. He was about to go and do great miracles. The Messianic anointing was about to appear as it is appearing now at the end of the age. God will not take it out or we will all be slaughtered and killed. He is going to have a translation and those left in the tribulation will flee “And all the people in the synagogue…were filled with wrath…. And they rose up and thrust him out of the city and led him unto the brow of the hill…that they might cast him down headlong” (vs. 28 & 29). He was going to inaugurate His ministry and they wanted to inaugurate His death. They laid a hold on Him but being that He was eternal and of the Holy Spirit completely, they could do nothing until the time came. They laid a hold on Him. They were going to throw Him down the cliff but something took place. e. “And he passing through the midst of them went his way” (v. 30). Somehow, Jesus reversed the atomic structures and molecules. When He did, He just disappeared and went to another place where He started His ministry. That is supernatural. All of a sudden, the boat that was on the sea was at the seashore (John 6: 21). This is in a different dimension that we don’t know about, but it took place. That alone ought to shock them, when He just disappeared. They couldn’t see Him any longer. He had disappeared. God can do these things. He doesn’t have to travel anywhere; all He has to do is to put you into a dimension. When He passed through the midst of them, He went His way. That is supernatural. He mentioned Elijah, the prophet, to whom the same thing occurred. Finally, he was caught up in the chariot of fire. So, there was a great miracle. He went out of their hands and disappeared. They were dealing with something supernatural. They couldn’t handle it. f. “And He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the Sabbath days” (v. 31). This verse said, “He came down.” He disappeared and came down. Well, Phillip was last seen talking to the Ethiopian eunuch; he disappeared and was seen in Azotus (Acts 8: 40). He was carried away by the Holy Spirit. We are going to come down on the throne. That is exactly what is going to happen. The power of the Lord will get the people in such a way that they are going to be caught up in ecstasy with the Lord. He will anoint the people to take them away. Just before they can reach out and mark you, you are going to disappear out of their hands. He will say, “Come up, hither.” Then, the mark will be issued. The foolish will be running and hiding in the wilderness but God will take His children. There will be forty-two months of wrath upon the earth. There will be seven years of tribulation; the last forty-two months will be the period of great tribulation upon the earth. g. “And they were astonished at his doctrine, for his word was with power” (v. 32). I got this from the Lord; His word got Him out of their hands and they couldn’t get a hold of Him. Enoch was walking around preaching the gospel and he just disappeared because God took him. This shows us that as this anointing increases and the power of God comes upon His people—let the world call it what they want to—the power and anointing (Messianic anoint) will become so strong that one day down the line, we are going to disappear and be with the Lord. As the anointing of the translation gets more potent and more powerful, just before the mark of the beast, He will take away His elect. The anointing at Capstone will become powerful. If you do not really mean business, you can’t stand it. It has nothing to do with man. It is not man’s work; it is the power of Christ. Before the mark of the beast can come on the people, the Lord will catch them away. So. We will grow until the bride becomes powerful.

It is the power of God that has kept me since I came (to Arizona) from California. I will be here until He calls me. It is predestinated and providential. I know that. I know that satan will pull all he wants to, but I have seen too much of the Lord. Praise the Lord Jesus! Always be confident, be ready and be found faithful. Faithfulness is one of the qualities of the bride. Let the power of the Lord remain in you in such a way that it will keep you confident, full of the light of the Lord. Believe what the Lord has said about the translation and the resurrection. Have no doubt about it; unbelief is sin.

“The Spirit of the Lord is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good things to the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound” (Isaiah 61: 1). This anointing will come again and do the same things that He did; the works that I did shall you do. If someone has problems overseas, I believe with my heart that they will appear and disappear. If someone needs to move a mountain, it shall be moved. This is the type of anointing that is in the thunders. These things are supernatural. They are not done by imagination, but according to the power of God. They are not done by wishful thinking, but according to the plans and patterns of God. He does not raise all the dead that are dead, but sometimes for the glory of God, He will raise somebody up. He does whatsoever he will. Before the end of the age, we will see people rising again. We will see the power of God.

There has been a lull, but the Lord will come again with a fiery power at the end of the age. You have to expect revival in your heart. You can pray but it will come at His time. It was time when He stepped out of eternity to be born as a baby. The gifts that the wise men brought prophesied what he would do. They brought gold which showed that He was a Royal King. Frankincense and myrrh showed his suffering, death and resurrection. It was timed for the shepherds to come first. It was timed for the wise men to come from the east. Everything was timed. Jesus knew exactly to the last second when the minister would hand Him the book of Isaiah in the synagogue. It was time and He stepped out of eternity to do what Isaiah prophesied. Isaiah predicted what He would do. He came several hundred years later in the gospel of Luke to fulfill that. When it is time, He will step right in to get us. He is here right now, but when He comes in a dimension, we will be gone with Him.

When He mentioned that he would deliver the people (in Luke) they wanted to kill Him, but he disappeared. The demon powers are real. They are the troublemakers that cause your sicknesses and troubles. When you know that, you have the victory. They confronted Jesus Christ and tried to kill Him. You want to block them with the word of God. Remember what they did to Jesus. He was looking at different dimensions when He was reading that scripture. He wanted to show His disciples what he was up against. He could have called for twelve legions of angels, but He died to save the people. Just where you are sitting, there are two dimensions, the physical and the supernatural. If you could see the supernatural, you cannot stay in this place. He is preparing you to be in the supernatural dimension. If you follow the word, you are brought into a supernatural dimension. Right where you are, there are angels all around. a. “…to comfort all that mourn” (Isaiah 61: 2). He came to the people that were destined. He had certain ones that He had to meet. He comforted those that mourned; those that came to him, sinners and all, He comforted them. b. “To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called the trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, that he might be glorified” (v. 3). No matter what sorrow or problem you have, He will give you the beauty of the Lord. There is an anointing that heals and casts devils out. There is an anointing that brings forth the oil of joy for mourning. If you enter into the anointing, you will wind up with a supernatural joy that you can’t buy, that you cannot understand. At the end of the age, He is going to give you the anointing of joy. The bride will have the anointing of joy before they meet the Bridegroom. Don’t allow yourself to be burdened. Begin to praise the Lord and the Spirit will pop the burden and get rid of that heaviness. The Spirit will pop the bubble of heaviness. This is coming from the Lord. The seven-fold anointing was with Jesus as He stood before them. There was a commotion in the other world. That anointing is coming upon the bride when people prepare their hearts. If you don’t believe in the supernatural, you can’t believe in anything. He will give the bride the garment of praise and remove the heaviness. The elect bride will have beauty for ashes. The Lord will replace all the heaviness with a kind of beauty from the Lord. Moses’s face was shining in the presence of the Lord. At the end of the age, your face will shine. The anointing will replace the offences and heaviness. Beauty for ashes will fall upon the bride. The mantel of praise will fall upon the bride. The bride makes herself ready. c. “…that they might be called the trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord” (v. 3). There is a true vine and a false vine. There is the bride that will be carried away. The vine of the Lord that He planted before the foundation of the world. People say the Lord delayeth His coming—scoffers— but that is when He is going to come. People will drift away. The people that love the Lord will not fall away. At the end of the age, wait and it will come. He said Israel will go to their homeland; they did. He said the former revival will come and it did. He said the latter rain will come; it will come with great power. It will come at the appropriate time. The power of the former and latter rain will come together and it will come with tremendous power. The rain must come at the appropriate time to have a bountiful harvest, great crop.

The power of the Lord will come on the people and they will have the oil of joy, beauty for ashes and the garment of praise. The rain has to come right. The tares will be bundled and separated from the true bride. They are bundled and locked up in the Babylonian system. They can’t come to the bride. The Lord will save some of them. At that time, the thunders will sound and this is typical of the great revival, the quick short work. When they are bundled, they can’t join the bride. The bride will be standing alone like Israel dwelled alone. But the bible said God was with them and they couldn’t touch them. The bride of the Lord will be alone in the power of God getting ready to go away.

I am waiting for what God told me. There is timing with the Lord. Don’t look for numbers and organizations. Wait on the Lord. Great things have happened in the building (Capstone Cathedral). We need more of the things we have. You are in a revival; each time I come here, there is great power. You can accept it or you can starve. We are in a revival. I feel it. I am not saying this is the last work of the Lord, but we are in a revival and much more is coming.

We are in a revival. The only thing we can do is to look for more. Don’t say God is not doing anything. He is always doing something. We have been in one of the greatest revivals in this building. Something is going on. Those that have faith, they can sit down with God. He is going to make rivers in the desert. We are the planting of the Lord. The wind of the Lord will move upon the planting. If people can’t catch this, wisdom is too high for a fool. He brought the message because He is going to sober you up and talk to you. Sitting in His presence, under this anointing, you are going to do more than some minsters.

“For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth” (Job 19: 25). Job suffered in ashes, mourning and under the oppression of his friends. He suffered for a moment. At the end, the Lord turned the ashes to beauty and gave him the garment of praise. This is typical of what the bride will experience. In spite of what his friends (organized religion) said, Job confessed, “I know that my redeemer liveth…. (vs. 25 – 27). The trials did not break him. Each of us should believe and hold these words. “Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me” (v. 27). I will not see another, but the One that passed through, the Lord. Out of these ashes came beauty. He was revived and he triumphed.

“Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and praise the Lord” Psalm 134: 2). “For who in the heaven can be compared unto the Lord…. God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints…” (Psalm 89: 6 & 7). “Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness….Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people…” (Psalm 107: 31 & 32). “Praise the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song and his praise in the congregation of saints” (Psalm 149: 1). He is telling you how to get the garment of praise. Exalt the Lord. Let’s look forward to more of this revival. He is going to put more smoke in it. Heat up the fire and let’s look up. We are going into a great power of God. The rain will come at the right time and bring a great crop.
